purpose: Minimal synthetic Pass-A input retained to exercise durable restart and retry-budget semantics. It is not PR39 scientific evidence.

places.description: Calibration habitat 12: an ordinary shared home with a kitchen, table, storage, and household notice area.
Calibration habitat 12: a general school with classrooms, a yard, and shared work areas.
Calibration habitat 12: a small public reading room with shelves, tables, and a staffed desk.
Calibration habitat 12: a neighborhood market for routine household purchases and errands.
Calibration habitat 12: a local transit stop used for ordinary school and neighborhood trips.
Calibration habitat 12: a shared community room used for practical activities, meetings, and workshops.

world.householdShape: one young person living with at least one caregiver, with ordinary access to peers and extended community adults
world.materialCircumstances: stable household resources with occasional reliance on community-shared equipment
world.mobilityPattern: ordinary neighborhood movement with school-day transit and occasional caregiver-accompanied errands
world.schoolingOrCommunityContext: a neighborhood school with teachers, peers, a small library, and occasional community workshops
world.culturalContext: synthetic off-cohort calibration community with ordinary household, school, market, reading, peer, and neighborhood routines; it represents no real biography or cohort location
world.intellectualEnvironment: ordinary exposure to books, classroom explanations, peer discussion, practical demonstrations, public information, and optional community activities

priorEpisodes.observableAction: The young person and caregiver placed two labeled envelopes beside the household notice area.

offeredStructures.abstractSituation: the young person hears or participates in a bounded argument in which at least two explicit reasons are offered
an artwork or performance the young person actually encounters violates one concrete expectation about form, audience, or subject
a peer shares an uncertain belief or interpretation and explicitly leaves room for doubt
a previously available mentor or teacher is temporarily unavailable at a moment when the young person expected ordinary guidance
a teacher or mentor makes one optional path, practice, text, or community available without assigning it as a requirement
the young person states a disagreement in a group where the social cost is visible but bounded
the young person experiences a visible failure in a chosen activity and has an ordinary opportunity to continue, alter, or leave it
the young person directly encounters a religious or philosophical text or discussion and attends to one explicit proposition without being assigned a conclusion
a text the young person actually reads presents a claim or perspective that conflicts with one stated expectation
